content: प्रपन्न {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Arriving at, reaching or going to. .²2 Resorting to, betaking oneself to; इयं प्रपन्ना तपसे तपोवनम् <ls>Ku. 5. 59</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">3. 5</ls>. .²3 Taking refuge with, seeking protection with, suppliant or submissive to; शिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम् <ls>Bg. 2. 7</ls>; पुनर्भवक्लेशभयात् प्रपन्नः Ku; प्रपन्नार्तिहरे! देवि! <ls>Chaṇḍīpāṭha.</ls> .²4 Adhering to. .²5 Furnished or endowed with, possessed of; प्रत्यक्षाभिः प्रपन्नस्तनुभिः <ls>Ś. 1. 1</ls>. .²6 Promised. .²7 Got, obtained. .²8 Poor, distressed. .²9 Effecting, producing.
